title: play flags --link, --quantum, --no-start-stop, --latency: help text, validation, exit codes
description:
## Intent
The command-line surface for Link on `play`. Makes apricitus-a4072b green.

## Steps
1. `crates/apricity-cli/src/main.rs`, `Cmd::Play`: `--link`; `--quantum <beats>` (1 to 16, default the score's time signature); `--no-start-stop`; `--latency <ms>` (-500 to 500). One-line doc comments become the `--help` text.
2. Value parsers that print the exact messages in the story; options needing `--link` refused with "X needs --link"; usage errors exit with status 2 before anything joins.
3. A score with mistakes is reported as today (`<score>: line L column C: …`) and exits 1 without joining.

## Verify
`cargo test -p apricity-cli --test link_play` (apricitus-a4072b green); `./target/debug/apricity play --help` shows the four options.

Commit: `feat(<this task id>): play --link options`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
